_comment: Reference only. Real settings live in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Voxylis\config\settings.json and are edited through the Settings UI. Secrets are never stored here: API keys and session tokens go to the OS credential store, and any plaintext *_api_key found in a settings file is migrated into the vault and stripped from the JSON.
_api_base_note: Backend the desktop app talks to for sign-in (Auth0 device flow) and plan checks. Empty = the local dashboard server (127.0.0.1:5000). Set to e.g. https://api.voxylis.com for a hosted backend.
